test_case.test_name: Variant-bound Mellanox BF4 board mechanical service and full-function restoration
test_case.purpose: Using the exact row/variant identity, verify one approved BF4 board/connector service cycle restores physical seating, every expected function/link and clean health without cross-executing the same-code Serial Port case.
required_package: BF4 FRU/slot/action and vendor service procedure
test_case.test_command: Select only `Functionality|2193|Wistron-HW-00473-V002` / `ffc4bccaceb1d632`. Capture BF4 identity/functions/links/errors and labeled photos. Technician isolates power and performs exactly one approved BF4 board or named connector reseat, restores retention/cables/power, then collect unique photos and complete BF4 PCIe/function/link/health/log evidence; do not repeat.
test_case.expected_result: The exact BF4 FRU is undamaged and seated per drawing, every expected function returns at its signed identity/link with matching firmware/driver and no prohibited AER/BMC/host errors; no Serial Port artifact is used.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only for this variant when physical and all-function electronic criteria match. Wrong variant/FRU, damage, missing function, downgrade or disallowed error is FAIL. Missing runtime action/procedure/oracle is BLOCKED before handling; duplicate code alone does not prevent composite-key execution.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until composite identity, FRU/action, authorization, vendor procedure and recovery are signed.
Qualified technician only with required power isolation/discharge/ESD/retention controls.
No code-only dispatch, force, live handling, unrestricted cycling, repeat, log clear or retry.
Stop on identity ambiguity, resistance, damage, power fault, missing/degraded function or errors.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant/hash and explicit exclusion of row 1978
Authorization, BF4 FRU/slot/action and signed service procedure
Pre/post all PCIe BDF/functions, links, firmware/driver, AER and BF4 health
Collision annotation, restored state, discrepancy/recovery and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on any mismatch. Leave the system in the approved safe state and escalate to the hardware owner; use only signed recovery and never another reseat or automatic retry.
